name: Module Name
description: Module Name,No range

name: User Name
description: User Name,the abbreviation of user,ASCII

name: Serial Number
description: Serial Number,No range

name: Software Version
description: Software Version,No range

name: Startup H-Pedel
description: 0:disable,1:enable,Startup H-Pedel Function,if throttle has effective signal when power-on,disable output and report this fault.

name: Brake H-Pedel
description: 0:disable,1:enable,Brake H-Pedel,if throttle has effective signal when release brake,disable output and report this fault.

name: NTL H-Pedel
description: 0:disable,1:enable,Neutral H-Pedel,if throttle has effective signal from N to Drive,disable output and report this fault.

name: Joystick
description: 0:disable,1:enable, Joystick throttle.

name: Three Gears Switch
description: 0:disable,1:enable,if enable Three Gears with Forward,Rev,NTL,if disable no NTL.

name: Boost
description: 0:disable,1:enable,if enable Max Current Output when power on the Boost switch.

name: Foot Switch
description: 0:disable,1:enable,if switch on,the throttle pedal is effective.

name: SW Level
description: 0:SW Low-Level effective;1:SW High-Level effective

name: 0,HIM;1,KIM
description: Controller Type,0:HIM;1:KIM.

name: Cruise
description: 0:disable,1:enable, The throttle to keep 3 seconds into the cruise state.

name: Change Dir
description: 0:disable,1:enable,If the direction of Motor is different with correct direction,you can set the bit.

name: Controller Volt
description: Controller Voltage,Range 0~612

name: Low Volt
description: The min Voltage value of reporting this fault

name: Over Volt
description: The max Voltage value of reporting this fault

name: Current Percent
description: Current Percent,Range 20~100%

name: Battry Current Limit
description: Battry Current Limit,Limit the max value of Battry Current,Range 20~100

description: Identify Motor Parameters Enable Flag，0x55 is disable，0xAA is enable

name: TPS Low
description: If lower than the value,report the fault of TPS Type,Range 0~20%

name: TPS High
description: If hifher than the value,report the fault of TPS Type,Range 80~100%

name: TPS Type
description: TPS Type,0:None,1:0-5V,2:1-4V,3:0-5K

name: TPS Dead Low
description: TPS Dead Zone Low,Range 0~40%.

name: TPS Dead High
description: TPS Dead Zone High,Range 60~100%.

name: TPS Rev MAP

name: Max Rev Speed%

name: NTL Brk Per%

name: Accel Release Time

name: Brake Time

description: Brake Release Time,the time of Brake Torque form max to 0,0.1~25.0s,accuracy 0.1s

description: BRK_SW Braking Percent,the per of BRK_SW in max braking,Range 0~100

name: Change Dir Brk%
description: Change direction Braking Percent，the per of 'Change direction Brk' in max braking.

name: Torque Speed Ki
description: Speed Integral Ki in Torque mode,Range 0~32767,actually used 0~3.9999

description: Speed Error Limit in Torque mode,Range 50~4095

description: Linear hall signal amplitude of the sine and cosine,>1.25 times and <0.75 times is a mistake,0~1024 is equal to 0~5V.

description: Linear hall signal is greater than this value is an error,0~1024 is equal to 0~5V.

name: Line Hall Low Err
